¿Cómo se obtiene el aceite de oliva virg: How is extra virgin olive oil made?
El aceite de oliva virgen extra es un zu: Extra virgin olive oil is a 100% natural juice that retains the aroma, flavour, vitamins and natural characteristics of the olive. It is the only vegetable oil that can be consumed exactly as it is obtained. It comes directly from olives through a mechanical extraction process — rather more involved than simply squeezing an orange.
Cuando la aceituna llega a la almazara l: When the olives arrive at the mill, they are first cleaned to remove leaves, small twigs and other material collected during harvesting. Once clean, they are ready for extraction, a process that consists essentially of four stages. Throughout the process, both olives and oil remain in contact with inert materials such as stainless steel to avoid unwanted changes.
. En un molino se tritura la aceituna pa: . The olives are crushed in a mill to break the cell structures that contain the oil — rather like using a very large kitchen blender. The result is an olive paste containing crushed flesh, pieces of stone and skin, oil and the olive’s natural water.
. En una batidora se mezcla bien la masa: . The olive paste is slowly mixed to make it uniform and encourage tiny droplets of oil to join together into larger drops. It is important that this stage does not exceed 90 minutes and that the paste remains below approximately 27–28°C.

En un decantador la masa es centrifugada: In a decanter, the paste is spun at high speed so its components separate according to density. Inside the cylindrical drum, the different components form concentric layers: the pomace, made up of olive solids, stone and skin with some moisture, forms the outer layer; the olive’s vegetation water forms the middle layer; and the less dense oil forms the innermost layer.
Para eliminar las últimas impurezas, seg: Different mills use different systems to remove the final traces of moisture and impurities. Common methods include vertical centrifuges, settling tanks and stainless-steel mesh filters. Once clean, the oil is ready to move to storage before bottling.
